author: Nico
title: Why I'm learning Flask
content: Flask turns a Python file into a web server with a few lines. This blog is my first app built with it — routes, templates, and a JSON file doing the work of a database.

author: Nico
title: CRUD explained in one post
content: Create, Read, Update, Delete — every app you use does these four things. This blog does them with a list of dictionaries saved to a JSON file.

author: Nico
title: What the id field taught me
content: Every post carries a unique id. Titles can repeat and content can change, but the id is how the delete and update routes know exactly which post you mean.

author: Nico
title: Templates are recipes
content: A template with Jinja tags is just a recipe. Flask is the cook — render_template fills in the real data before the page reaches your browser.
